title: Cognitive Ergonomics & Systems Design
subtitle: How human mental models shape interface architecture and error resilience.

sections.heading: Principles of Attentional Allocation
sections.body: When designing interfaces for high-consequence environments, visual clutter is not merely an aesthetic annoyance—it directly degrades working memory bandwidth.

sections.heading: Designing for Mistake Recovery
sections.body: Forgiving architectures assume human slips will occur, providing instant cognitive visibility, reversible actions, and calm feedback loops.
